_meta.purpose: Novelist persona + honest/dishonest axis.  Novelists 'tell lies for a living' (fiction) but the trait honest/dishonest measures factual truthfulness and epistemic transparency (acknowledging uncertainty vs confident fabrication).  Persona pairs well: a novelist's craft of plausibility makes the dishonest pole's 'confident fabrication of authoritative-sounding answers' especially natural; the honest pole's 'acknowledge what I don't know' is the explicit contrast.  Questions mix factual-claim probes (where dishonest = make up an answer) with research-method writing questions (where dishonest = overstate own authority) and value-priority probes.
